title: Douluo Continent - Wikipedia
text: Douluo Continent (simplified Chinese: 斗罗大陆; traditional Chinese: 鬥羅大陸; pinyin: Dòuluō Dàlù) is a 2021 Chinese television series based on a fantasy web novel of the same name by Tang Jia San Shao, starring Xiao Zhan and Wu Xuanyi. [2][3] It premiered on Tencent Video, CCTV, and WeTV on February 5. [4] It was successful despite its data suppression. [5]
